phase: W2b-2: input in the browser host
change: NTSDWeb: page functions for input (a 256-event shared ring: keys as USB HID usages with the typed character, repeat and Caps Lock; mouse messages in canvas pixels with MK buttons; a Caps Lock report), gamepads (the first two, kept in their slots, the d-pad over the left stick, A/B/X/Y; a pad that goes away reads centred), questions (MessageBoxA, alerts, unsupported-boundary stops: the worker posts the question and waits on a shared flag; the page shows a modal) and links (http(s) only, as a notice the player clicks). The host drains input every 2 ms on the main queue (the SDL host's pump), samples gamepads every 25 ms, keeps the overlay in /save when the page mounts one, and ends with code 1 after a stop. The page releases every held key and button on blur, pagehide, hiding and a question; syncs mouse buttons from every pointer event; moves before a tap's press and holds a tap's release; leaves Cmd to the browser; sends macOS Caps Lock as a whole press per change; types Ctrl+letter's control code; waits for a player's gesture before starting (browsers show gamepads and allow sound only after one). web_run.mjs: --interactive, --answer N, --steps (DevTools-protocol keys and clicks held 120 ms, canvas captures, page logs), --timeout, --serve PORT (a player's own browser), signal cleanup.

interactive.how: web_run.mjs --interactive --answer 0 --steps in headless Chromium (keys and clicks over the DevTools protocol; captures kept in X5 tw-w2b2/interactive)
results: a held click on START opened the mode menu (captures a-menu.png, b-after-start.png)
Escape reached the game: 'Are you sure to quit?' with buttons Yes/No asked on the page; Yes quit with code 0, No kept playing
the start gate: canvas 300x150 (not started) before a click, 794x550 frames after it
interactive.notTested: gamepads (no virtual gamepad in headless browsers; a player's check), WebKit interactive (no DevTools protocol on its build), touch on a real device

bugsFoundInTesting: web_run.mjs: a brace-less if after adding --steps answered every request with the config (programs got the config instead of their files and ended at once); found by request logging, fixed
WebInput.ask: an untyped buttons.flatMap { Array($0.utf8) + [0] } inferred [[Any]] (the deprecated optional flatMap), so the buttons arrived empty; typed loop
killed runs (perl alarm) left 28 headless browsers running; web_run.mjs now has --timeout and closes its browser on SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP/SIGALRM
review: Round 1: high: keys stuck after focus loss (Alt+Tab left Alt down, making every key a system key and F4 a quit); medium: a second mouse button's press missed, gamepads invisible without a gesture before launch; low: disconnected pads held, Cmd keys stuck, Caps Lock, Ctrl+letter characters, timers keeping a stopped worker alive, ring counter wrap, window.open blocked, touch. All fixed. Round 2: OK; low: taps pressed at the previous point, drags from the margin made clicks, releases of unseen keys, the gate text, macOS Caps Lock doubling, a stop exiting 0, the explore link. All fixed.
